properties.description:
Planned 2026-10-07, build order 6 of 7, after F2 so the offers are worth reading. F1 widens unreviewed_ideas, or adds a sibling finding, to requirements and accepted ideas that relate to nothing beyond their author, project or satisfaction. F5: capture-intent runs relation_candidates after a requirement is written and puts the candidates to the person, as link-ideas does.



AS BUILT 2026-10-08 (item 6):
- F1 is a sibling finding, not a widening of unreviewed_ideas: `unlinked_intent` (relate.rs) lists live requirements and accepted decisions with no review relation, no DECOMPOSES and no GOVERNED_BY in either direction, and no no_relation_note. Parked nodes and decisions still weighing two or more alternatives are left out. A capability satisfying a requirement is not counted as a link.
- detect_gaps reports one aggregate low-severity finding (0.25) with its denominator. On reflow2's own design it read 134 of 890.
- link-ideas works it alongside unreviewed_ideas.
- F5: capture-intent calls relation_candidates on a new requirement, puts the real candidates to the person, and links the ones they confirm.


- NOT ASKED BELOW SIX (detect.rs UNLINKED_INTENT_FLOOR), added 2026-10-08 after the full suite found it firing on the one-requirement and complete-thread fixtures that pin "nothing specific is wrong". Below six live requirements and accepted decisions, the intent is read whole, so nothing is lost to a search. Six is the pool size item 3 chose as the smallest worth reasoning about. This floor is my call, made inside Anthony's merge-when-green authorisation, not a ruling of his.
- unlinked_intent reads parking, so it is in PARKING_READERS and its finding carries the parks sentence.
properties.name: Missing links are looked for on requirements and accepted ideas, not only open ideas (F1), and capturing a requirement offers its likely relations (F5)
